rules.rationale: A new stud partition needs studs, plates, noggins, fixings, board, board screws, insulation, tape and jointing compound.
Merchants split fittings by joint technology, so the kit carries one family only.
Merchants split fittings by joint technology, so the kit carries one family only.
Merchants split fittings by joint technology, so the kit carries one family only.
Tiling needs adhesive, grout, spacers and a primed substrate.
A tiled floor needs tiles, adhesive and grout and no sheet vinyl.
Sheet vinyl is welded and sealed to sanitaryware; no floor tiles.

A wall-hung WC needs a concealed frame, a flush plate and a wall-hung pan. The frames cited ship a 90 mm bend with a 90/110 mm adaptor, so a separate 110 mm pan connector is not added (this differs from the original brief). Plate must match the cistern maker and series; that compatibility is a SKU check, not encoded here.
A close-coupled suite is bought as pan, cistern, seat and lever, plus a pan connector chosen by the soil outlet and an isolating valve on the cistern feed.
A back-to-wall WC needs its pan, a concealed cistern with a flush button, a unit or boxing to hide it, a seat and an isolating valve; no frame.
A basin needs a waste (slotted or unslotted to match its overflow), a 32 mm trap with a 75 mm seal and isolating valves on its feeds.
A wall-hung basin on a stud wall needs backing for its fixings.
A vanity basin replaces the pedestal or wall-hung basin.

The fan needs a local all-pole isolator (3 mm gap), 100 mm duct, an external terminal and a condensation trap. The source asks for the trap on moisture-laden ducted air; it is always included here and can be unticked on site. Rates come from parameters, not the template.
Mira guides warn stud partitions may need alternative fixings; wall fixings are not supplied.
Wall fixings suited to the substrate are not supplied.
With no openable window the fan must run on after the room is left (Approved Document F).

Line option: evidence_grade (A-D), why_default and price_band {min, max, currency, per, vat, observed_on, basis} (prices are dated observations, not quotes).
Line: forced_by {text, source_url} (a rule fixes this line; explain it, do not offer a choice) and help.
